title: Isolation of Protoplasts from Marchantia Gemmae
author: Eftychis Frangedakis

steps.title: Grow Marchantia gemmae
steps.instruction: Grow gemmae on ½ Gamborg B5 plus vitamins media plates (covered) for 4 days.

steps.title: Pre-incubate gemmae
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml of 8% (w/v) mannitol at pH 5.7 to the plate and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare 2% Driselase solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the enzyme solution by mixing Driselase with mannitol.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2 g Driselase to 10 ml 8% mannitol solution.
Incubate in the dark for 20 min at room temperature, gently inverting to mix at intervals.
Centrifuge at 3.3k rpm for 3 min.
Filter sterilize the supernatant using a 0.2 μm syringe filter.

steps.title: Digest gemmae to release protoplasts
steps.instruction: Digest the gemmae using the prepared Driselase solution.

substeps.instruction: Replace the initial mannitol solution with 5 ml 2% Driselase.
Incubate at room temperature for 4 hours with gentle shaking (50 rpm).
Using a tip, gently release protoplasts from the gemmae ('dissolve the gemmae').

steps.title: Filter and concentrate protoplasts
steps.instruction: Filter the solution and pellet the cells.

substeps.instruction: Filter the solution through a 70 μm cell strainer into a 50 ml falcon tube, then transfer to a round bottom falcon tube.
Incubate for a further 10 min.
Centrifuge at 120 x g for 3 min.
Remove the supernatant without disturbing the cells.
Re-suspend cells in 6 ml 8% mannitol (mix by swirling, not shaking).
Centrifuge at 120 x g for 3 min.
Repeat the wash process 2 times.

steps.title: Prepare for overnight incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare the cells for overnight storage.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 μl 50% glucose to the autoclaved liquid Gamborg B5 plus vitamins + mannitol solution.
Wrap tubes in foil to keep them dark.
Leave tubes at 25°C overnight.

steps.title: Prepare Regeneration Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the PRMB and PRMT media layers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PRMB (Bottom layer): 1.57 g Gamborg B5 plus vitamins, 30 g mannitol, pH 5.7, 4 g agar, dH2O to 495 ml. Autoclave and keep at 50°C.
Prepare PRMT (Top layer): 0.0948 g Gamborg B5 plus vitamins, 1.6 g mannitol, 0.1 g agar, pH 5.7, dH2O to 19.6 ml. Autoclave and keep at 50°C.
Add 5 ml sterile 50% glucose to PRMB and pour into 90 mm plates.

steps.title: Plate protoplasts
steps.instruction: Resuspend and plate the protoplasts onto the regeneration media.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 120 x g for 4 min.
Remove supernatant and gently re-suspend the pellet in 8% mannitol (0.5 ml if plating on 3 plates, or 0.8 ml if using 4 plates).
Add 2.5 ml PRMT to each cell suspension (sufficient for 3 plates).
Quickly but gently mix by pipetting up and down.
Plate 1 ml of the suspension onto each PRMB plate.
